title: Bandit Toll
description: Three rough figures emerge from behind rusted sawmill machinery, blocking your path. Their leader, a scarred woman with a notched axe, spits at your feet. 'Toll's ten gold. Pay up or we take it from your corpse.'

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.description: Hand over 10 gold. At least you spot some wood scraps nearby.

choices.label: Stand your ground
choices.description: Show them you won't be easy prey.

choices.label: Run for it
choices.description: They look slow. Maybe you can outrun them.
